about: A playbook and checker that catches common App Store and Google Play rejection causes before you submit.

prs.title: Removed Android permissions no longer block a release
prs.broken: The checker flagged a permission even on the line that removes it. Apps that stripped risky permissions were still marked blocked.
prs.changed: I made four permission checks read each manifest entry and skip ones marked for removal.
prs.matters: Apps that drop risky permissions pass instead of being blocked by mistake.
